request.query: A polynomial p over any semiring is sum of C coeff p i times X power i for i in range n when natDegree p less than n

items.name: Polynomial.as_sum_range'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  p.natDegree < n → p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Polynomial.monomial i) (p.coeff i)

items.name: Polynomial.as_sum_range
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R),
  p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), (Polynomial.monomial i) (p.coeff i)

items.name: Polynomial.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) {n : ℕ},
  p.natDegree < n → p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Polynomial.C (p.coeff i) * Polynomial.X ^ i

items.name: Polynomial.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R),
  p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), Polynomial.C (p.coeff i) * Polynomial.X ^ i

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R}, p.degree < ↑n → p.coeff n = 0
